name: podcast-skill-graph
rule: Every AI agent must attach to exactly one step node for one subject (VENTOSA_AGENT=<name> ventosa-graph attach <step> <ID>) before doing pipeline work, follow that node's skill, and write only through `ventosa-graph write`. The write gate refuses writes without the agent's matching attachment. Parallel agents each hold their own single attachment.
elevate: Decisions to elevate (decision_ask with options, never guess): the subject's angle or thesis when the labels leave it open; anything said about a real person, brand or sponsor; claims without a source in the knowledge; spending money or calling a paid API beyond the batch limits; publishing, uploading or scheduling anything public; deleting or overwriting the human's takes, edits or labels. Edge cases: missing or contradictory knowledge files; a take or edit that is too short, silent or corrupt; two subjects with the same title; a step whose input is older than its output. Dangerous scenarios (stop and elevate): legal, medical or financial advice; copyrighted music or footage; personal data of anyone but the host; credentials or keys appearing in any file.

steps.need: write ≥2 thesis options (or one more if the human asked)
write one full script version per option (scripts/<ID>/<KEY>-slug.md)
steps.done_when: every option has a version registered with ai_write.py draft (or the label is already approved)

steps.need: choose: activate a script version, or approve a paragraph stack
steps.done_when: label approved (activating a version approves it)

steps.need: write a version from an approved stack and activate it (skipped when the human activated a version)
steps.done_when: episodes/NN-*.md (active copy) status: final and label_rev = label.rev

steps.need: shoot on the external camera, paste files in the inbox, import + keep/discard in Record app
steps.done_when: every clip line recorded or parked

steps.need: link the teleprompter takes to the media files by time (media_list, teleprompter_log) and flag files with no match
ventosa-graph edit <ID> then sign off with edit-done
steps.done_when: assets/edits/<ID>-final.mp4 signed off with ai_write.py edit-done, newer than the newest kept take

steps.need: pick + approve title/description in Label app
upload to the platform's upload page, mark uploaded

knowledge.what: writing policy, sponsor structure, three acts, voice, don'ts
